policy.scope: Initial ceilings for NEW launches only. Existing jobs continue unchanged. No elapsed-time stop or automatic interruption.
policy.memory_rule: Before every launch, subtract the new worker reservation and outstanding growth reservations for active workers across both coordinators from current MemAvailable. Ceilings do not override this check.
